set.body:
Objective:
Incorporate the mathematical core of fmrireg.cca as a small, powerful one-shot MVPA method: leave-one-run-out largest-root canonical contrast analysis over arbitrary MVPA feature sets, without trialwise beta estimates, time-by-time projectors, or a CCA-specific execution engine.

Architectural proof:
prepared response plus design plus contrast -> runwise second-order moments -> effect/residual generalized Rayleigh problem -> Gale symmetric-definite eigensolve -> typed canonical result through existing MVPA fold and feature-set execution.

Ownership:
- Gale owns generic matrix/operator storage, symmetric and positive-definite evidence, generalized symmetric eigensolves, diagnostics, and backend routing.
- scalafim multivar owns the CanonicalEffect scientific problem/result and lowers it through the typed operator core and Gale primitives.
- fit owns prepared contrast geometry, censoring, whitening, temporal nuisance semantics, residual degrees of freedom, and preparation receipts.
- mvpa-fit owns runwise feature-set moment accumulation, fold-safe training/evaluation, and integration with MVPA results.
- mvpa retains generic folds, feature sets, metrics, and result traversal.
- The existing paired-family migration bd-01KXSGZ3JXDTCAKBHWN8G549B8 continues to own ordinary paired CCA and directed RRR. This epic does not create a second paired CCA engine.

Version-one method:
- one explicit contrast;
- largest canonical root only;
- signed unconstrained feature weights;
- explicit residual regularization;
- leave-one-independent-run-out training and frozen-direction held-out evaluation;
- scalar feature-set statistic plus typed fit, numerical diagnostics, and preparation receipt;
- shared implementation verified on JVM and Scala.js.

Non-goals:
No steerable spatial channels, nonnegative/simplex CCA, Step-1/Step-2 R engine, full MANOVA statistic catalog, probabilistic CCA, new fold/searchlight framework, or generic linear algebra duplicated inside scalafim. Trial-space canonical regression and beta-free RSA are possible follow-ons after this vertical slice proves the composition.

Epic acceptance:
All child gates are complete; a realistic ROI/searchlight scenario executes from prepared 4D response data to held-out canonical contrast results without a beta artifact; dense projector and fmrireg.cca fixtures agree; leakage sentinels pass; JVM and JS tests pass; module/dependency scans show one numerical engine; and documentation explains the estimand without calling symmetric association a classifier.
set.title: Epic: CCA one-shot MVPA — canonical contrast roots through existing abstractions
